note: Set A is better because it extracts claims from multiple schedules (Equipment, Plumbing, Finishes, Floor Finish, Millwork), providing significantly broader coverage than Set B which is limited to Millwork. Although Set A contains three misbound claims where attributes were swapped between Shower Valve and Vinyl Composite Tile, and both sets suffer from duplicate Millwork entries, Set A's comprehensive data capture outweighs these errors. Both sets miss important facts (Furniture, most Equipment and Plumbing), but Set B's omissions are far more severe.
